voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: The family sat down and ate breakfast together. And that's when the Nintendo on the floor began to buzz and vibrate. A huge, swirling portal burst open in the middle of the kitchen. The walls, the table, the breakfast — everything stopped, then twisted and turned into a strange, mythical world. And before anyone could grab the doorframe... Whoosh. The whole family was pulled inside the video game.
